title: Only 7% Can Pass This Vision Test
summary: Colours, tiny details, patterns, rotations and visual traps combine in one focused vision challenge.

landing.intro: How sharp are your eyes? Spot tiny differences, track shifting patterns and catch visual traps before they catch you.

startPrompt.title: Vision Test Ready 👁️
startPrompt.copy: Watch a short ad to start the test.

about.body:
This Optical Focus Lab condenses colour contrast, tiny details, patterns, visual memory, attention and spatial reasoning into one varied ten-question challenge. Each screen uses a different visual task, from fast comparisons to a genuine contrast illusion and two-step rotations.

The quiz is designed for worldwide entertainment and general learning. It measures only how accurately you answer the puzzles shown on your current screen; brightness, display calibration, screen size, viewing distance and surrounding light can all affect what you see.

Your final percentage reflects your answers in this quiz, not the health or quality of your eyesight. A real vision assessment requires appropriate equipment and a qualified eye-care professional. The 7% headline and participation figure are promotional entertainment wording, not live performance data.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Complete ten varied visual challenges and choose the single answer best supported by what is shown.
Correct answers stay hidden while you play, so compare colours, symbols, records and rotations carefully.
Finish the test to reveal your Vision Score, strongest visual skill and complete result report.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment only. This quiz is not an eye examination and cannot diagnose vision conditions.

profiles.title: The Eagle Eye
profiles.copy: You caught subtle shifts that most people would scan straight past. Your focus stayed exceptionally precise as the patterns, rotations and visual traps became harder.

profiles.title: The Visual Virtuoso
profiles.copy: You passed the challenge with a sharp eye for structure, contrast and tiny changes. Even the late-round optical traps rarely pulled your attention off course.

profiles.title: The Pattern Spotter
profiles.copy: You tracked most visual rules confidently and noticed details hidden inside busy displays. A few close comparisons made the focus lab genuinely challenging.

profiles.title: The Detail Detective
profiles.copy: You built a solid result across several kinds of visual puzzle. Your strongest round shows where your attention naturally locks on fastest.

profiles.title: The Focus Finder
profiles.copy: You uncovered plenty of the lab’s hidden clues while discovering which visual traps slow you down. A second look would make many of the missed patterns click.

profiles.title: The Curious Observer
profiles.copy: This set of visual traps found some blind spots, but it also revealed where your focus is strongest. Every missed clue becomes obvious once the underlying rule is exposed.

insights.overview: Your vision score at a glance

details.analysisTitle: How to read your vision score
details.analysisCopy: This ten-question result combines colour contrast, visual memory, fine-detail detection, focused attention, pattern tracking and spatial reasoning. Each answer moves the percentage by ten points, so the three skill groups below add useful context to the headline score.
details.roadmapIntro: Your score is only the first signal. Continue through the report to see which visual skills held strongest and where the hardest traps caught your attention.
details.positionCopy: The entertainment challenge target is eight correct answers out of ten. Your marker shows how close this attempt came; it does not assess eyesight or eye health.
details.measuredIntro: The ten challenges span three broad parts of visual puzzle-solving on your current screen.

measuredAreas.title: Colour and memory
measuredAreas.copy: Comparing contrast and briefly holding visual arrangements in mind.

measuredAreas.title: Detail and attention
measuredAreas.copy: Finding exact changes, repeated codes and small differences without losing focus.

measuredAreas.title: Patterns and space
measuredAreas.copy: Tracking alternating rules, mirror directions and multi-step rotations.

details.tipsTitle: Three ways to sharpen visual focus
details.tipsIntro: These are puzzle strategies only—not eyesight advice or a substitute for an eye examination.

tips.title: Scan in a fixed order
tips.copy: Move methodically across a grid instead of letting the most striking item pull your attention around.

tips.title: Separate the rules
tips.copy: When two patterns overlap, track shape, colour, fill or direction one feature at a time.

tips.title: Compare anchors first
tips.copy: In near-matching records, check fixed groups and endpoints before inspecting every character.
